title: Centroids
statementMd:
*Tree* is a connected acyclic graph. Suppose you are given a tree consisting of $*n*$ vertices. The vertex of this tree is called *centroid* if the size of each connected component that appears if this vertex is removed from the tree doesn't exceed ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png).

You are given a tree of size $*n*$ and can perform no more than one edge replacement. *Edge replacement* is the operation of removing one edge from the tree (without deleting incident vertices) and inserting one new edge (without adding new vertices) in such a way that the graph remains a tree. For each vertex you have to determine if it's possible to make it centroid by performing no more than one edge replacement.

## Input

The first line of the input contains an integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 400 000$) — the number of vertices in the tree. Each of the next $*n* - 1$ lines contains a pair of vertex indices $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) — endpoints of the corresponding edge.

## Output

Print $*n*$ integers. The $*i*$-th of them should be equal to $1$ if the $*i*$-th vertex can be made centroid by replacing no more than one edge, and should be equal to $0$ otherwise.

## Note

In the first sample each vertex can be made a centroid. For example, in order to turn vertex $1$ to centroid one have to replace the edge $(2, 3)$ with the edge $(1, 3)$.
statementZhMd:
*树*是一个连通无环图。假设给定一棵由 $*n*$ 个顶点组成的树。如果删除该树中的某个顶点后产生的每个连通分量的大小都不超过 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a64c1b2df604f8cfa9acf6716a3cc1424488361e.png)，则称该顶点为这棵树的*重心*。

给定一棵大小为 $*n*$ 的树，你至多可以进行一次边替换。*边替换*指从树中删除一条边（但不删除与其相连的顶点），再插入一条新边（但不添加新顶点），并且操作后图仍然是一棵树。对于每个顶点，请判断是否可以通过至多一次边替换使其成为重心。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 400 000$）——树中顶点的数量。接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行中，每行包含一对顶点编号 $*u*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$）——对应边的两个端点。

## 输出格式

输出 $*n*$ 个整数。如果第 $*i*$ 个顶点可以通过替换至多一条边成为重心，则第 $*i*$ 个整数应为 $1$；否则应为 $0$。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，每个顶点都可以成为重心。例如，要使顶点 $1$ 成为重心，可以将边 $(2, 3)$ 替换为边 $(1, 3)$。
